features.name: regime__realized_vol
features.description: Snapshot-safe short-horizon realized volatility derived from recent tick returns.

features.name: regime__iv_atm
features.description: At-the-money implied volatility estimated from best bid/ask option quotes.

features.name: regime__liquidity_score
features.description: Composite liquidity score combining spread tightness, top-level depth, and order updates normalized to [0,1].

features.name: regime__volatility_spike_flag
features.description: Boolean indicator for abrupt realized volatility expansion relative to the prior snapshot.

features.name: regime__spread_stability
features.description: Normalized stability score of the bid-ask spread using current vs previous spread.

features.name: regime__orderflow_extremeness
features.description: Z-scored signed orderflow intensity relative to recent baseline.

features.name: regime__market_state_flag
features.description: Categorical snapshot market state derived from directional moves and flow balance without future data.

features.name: regime__spread_zscore
features.description: Z-score of current bid-ask spread relative to a stationary baseline.

features.name: regime__liquidity_fractal_index
features.description: Fractal-style irregularity measure of micro-liquidity evolution between consecutive snapshots.

features.name: regime__depth_stress_ratio
features.description: Ratio indicating stress in top-of-book depth relative to spread conditions.

features.name: regime__volatility_compression_flag
features.description: Boolean flag for realized volatility contraction compared to the prior snapshot.

features.name: regime__momentum_ignition_flag
features.description: Composite ignition signal from bursty orderflow, tightening spreads, and rising volatility using snapshot inputs.

features.name: regime__spread_regime_crossover
features.description: Flag indicating transition into or out of a high-spread regime without forward lookahead.

features.name: regime__short_term_vol_forecast_error
features.description: Difference between realized volatility and a short-term forecast using only contemporaneous inputs.

features.name: regime__micro_liquidity_index
features.description: Composite micro-liquidity health index normalized to [0,1] from spread and depth quality.
